design_philosophy: Holded.com clone style tailored for OpenFactura. Clean, modern, highly professional SaaS. Heavy use of whitespace, bold geometric typography, high-contrast dark sections alternating with pristine white sections. Vibrant cobalt blue as the primary action color. Use of floating 'fake UI' mockups built with HTML/CSS instead of stock photos to show product value directly.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST build this entirely in /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.js (or .jsx). You can create local components within the same file or in a components folder.
Follow the Holded.com aesthetic strictly: crisp white backgrounds, very dark slate sections, vibrant #0052FF accents, large geometric typography (Outfit font).
DO NOT USE STOCK PHOTOS. Use HTML/Tailwind to build abstract 'browser window' mockups for the dashboard, invoice, and tax features. This is critical for the high-end SaaS look.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and links.
Ensure perfect responsive design (mobile-first). The zig-zag feature sections should stack nicely on mobile.
Use Lucide-react for all icons (checkmarks, feature icons, integration logos if needed).
Do NOT change routing. Just replace the Landing page content.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for the sticky header. Ensure it has backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent white background.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
